_about: Publications manifest, generated by scripts/build_research.py. Do not edit by hand.

publications.title: When Your Role Starts Changing
publications.subtitle: What people navigating AI-driven role change say about identity, fear, and what they want next
publications.summary: A living research paper on the individual side of AI-driven change: where role change is felt, who names fear and who doesn't, why people ask for a map rather than a course, and what kind of support they actually want. Built from InsightsOut workshop registrations and updated as new waves land.
changelog: v1.0 · August 2026 · First edition. Draws mainly on the two 'When Your Role Starts Changing' waves (n=163) inside the 9-wave, 363-person dataset, March–July 2026.

publications.title: Working Through AI Change
publications.subtitle: What 363 founders, managers, and professionals tell us before anyone surveys them
publications.summary: A living research paper on the human side of AI-driven change, built from InsightsOut workshop registrations and read against Gallup, Microsoft, MIT SMR, SHRM, and Anthropic. Updated as each new wave of events lands.
changelog: v1.0 · August 2026 · First edition. 9 waves, 444 registrations, 363 unique people, March–July 2026.

publications.title: From Overwhelm to Clarity
publications.subtitle: What 197 founders carry into the room — and why it isn't a time-management problem
publications.summary: A living research paper on the founder side of AI-driven change: an early-stage room where money and customers come first, overwhelm is pace and fragmentation rather than hours, fear goes mostly unnamed, and what people quietly want is a place to think with peers. Built from InsightsOut founder workshop registrations and updated as new waves land.
changelog: v1.0 · August 2026 · First edition. Founders are 197 of the 363 people in the 9-wave dataset (Mar–Jul 2026); founder-only waves are FIC-OPEN, FIC-AI, OTC, OTF.
